summary: End-to-end testing of new Job Transfer feature (backend + frontend). All 5 pytest cases pass and the full UI flow works: hover reveals ArrowRightLeft transfer button, transfer dialog opens (stopPropagation prevents navigation), company-user dropdown populates, confirm button enables on selection, transfer succeeds, job disappears from owner's dashboard, and Cancel closes the dialog cleanly. Regression checks (complete-checkbox, edit/delete buttons, job search) still work.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/jobs.py GET /users/transferable returns 401 (correct) but the endpoint also depends on get_current_user; consider caching in future if user list grows large.

POST /jobs/{job_id}/transfer relies on can_access_job which returns 404 for non-owner non-admin — behaviour matches spec but the message 'Job not found or access denied' conflates two states. Minor UX nit only.
JobsList.jsx: openTransferDialog calls axios.get('/users/transferable') every time the button is clicked. Consider caching the user list per dashboard session to avoid repeated round trips.

test_credentials.md notes tim.gables@byers.com has been terminated but no is_active flag was found on the user document; if the intent is to prevent transfers to terminated accounts, add an is_active check inside get_transferable_users.
test_credentials: Fresh @byers.com users are registered per-run via /api/auth/register (e.g. test_transfer_<hex>@byers.com / TestTransfer@2026) — they are NOT cleaned up because there is no DELETE-user endpoint. Not a blocker (they are only transfer targets). Master admin and mitchell.curlee@byers.com credentials in test_credentials.md are valid.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates jobs prefixed TEST_TRANSFER_/TEST_OUT_/TEST_FE_XFER_/TEST_CANCEL_/TEST_REG_ and deletes them at teardown. Seed job A050ABC (e5dc0bae-96bb-4cef-8001-7baf4e41d80a) was NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job Transfer feature verified end-to-end on 2026-01-22. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_job_transfer.py covers auth, filter, sort, exclude-caller, owner+admin transfer, 400 missing user_id, 404 nonexistent target, 404 non-owner-non-admin, admin transfer-back, and rejection of non-company target. Frontend flow tested via Playwright: month-folder click required before job cards are visible (dashboard groups by month). Transfer button revealed via .hover() then force-clicked. Dialog closes on Cancel and after successful transfer; toast appears via sonner. No open bugs.
